top_signals.title: Burnham Enters World Stage With Debut Foreign Trip to Ukraine
top_signals.summary: Andy Burnham is traveling to Ukraine on Monday for his first international trip as British prime minister, in an attempt to show he’ll maintain diplomatic and military support for Kyiv as Russia’s war enters a decisive phase.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
